files.description: Primary (b)(10) EHI export documentation. 9-page PDF dated September 2023, version 3. Describes CCD-based single-patient and bulk export with data element mapping tables covering ~22 CDA sections (demographics, problems, medications, allergies, labs, vitals, immunizations, procedures, encounters, social history, goals, care team, implants, mental/functional status, health concerns). Includes screenshots of the export interface showing selectable sections, bulk export with date range and provider filters, and an export scheduler for recurring exports.

FHIR R4 API documentation for §170.315(g)(10). 11-page PDF dated November 2024. Documents the Capella FHIR API at fhir.capellaehr.com/r4 supporting US Core 3.1.1 and Bulk Data export. Relevant as context for understanding the distinction between the vendor's (g)(10) FHIR API and their (b)(10) CCD export — they are separate mechanisms.

API documentation for §170.315(g)(7) and (g)(9) — patient and application selection services. 9-page PDF dated July 2024. Documents the single-patient FHIR API. Provides additional context on the vendor's API ecosystem but is not the (b)(10) export mechanism.

Full-page screenshot of the certification page showing the page layout, certification details, API documentation links, and the EHI export documentation link under 'Capella EHR Documentation' section.
